answers.eventTitle: Convocation Seating Arrangement (Auditorium & Exam Hall, AIIMS Kalyani)
answers.notes: AIIMS Kalyani Convocation layout: Main Auditorium (750 seats, Balcony: 132 seats) + Exam Section Hall (100 seats: 10x10 for overflow parents), VIP and visiting dignitaries in center rows B–C, faculty in center rows D–R, reporters in right rows A–D, admin in right mid-front, IT staff in left middle, MBBS in left (split around IT), nursing in left back + center W12–W20, PG in center rows U–V, guides in left row A, rank holders in left row B, overflow parents in center rows S–U.
